subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like tool failures with detail payloads be suppressed in every context, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose detail warnings remain visible?
rationale: Existing tests intentionally surface some detailed exec warnings, while the PR and linked issue ask for suppressing exec-like warnings regardless of `includeDetails`; automation cannot choose that user-facing policy safely.

options.title: Clarify And Revise Before Merge
options.body: Decide the intended exception set, then update the policy ordering and tests so benign chat noise is suppressed without accidentally hiding useful cron, heartbeat, or full-verbose diagnostics.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Accept hiding detailed exec-like warning payloads in every context and require matching test updates plus real behavior proof.

options.title: Preserve Current Detail Warnings
options.body: Keep cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose exec detail warnings visible and narrow or close the linked request if those warnings are intentional.

recommendation.title: Clarify And Revise Before Merge
recommendation.body: Decide the intended exception set, then update the policy ordering and tests so benign chat noise is suppressed without accidentally hiding useful cron, heartbeat, or full-verbose diagnostics.
